release_read.basis: Q3 beat (adj EPS $0.18 vs Nasdaq $0.17, record $1.37bn adj revenue, 34% EBITDA margin) and FY EBITDA guide raised to ~$1.66bn plus a first 2027 outlook ($0.90 EPS), but FY adjusted net income ($840m) and EPS ($0.61) only maintained again - the 'revenue up, profit held' shape that sold off three times - and cumulative fair-value adjustments on the loan book fell from $2.03bn to $1.40bn as discount rates rose 76-90bp, which is the thesis's rate/spread hit showing up in the marks.

release.headline: SoFi Q3 2026: record adjusted net revenue $1.37bn (+44%), adj EBITDA $470m, net income $241m, EPS $0.18; raises 2026 guidance, introduces 2027 outlook

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback, 8 estimates)

key_line.metric: FY2026 profit guide / H2 EBITDA margin
key_line.detail: Q3 EBITDA margin 34% (hunt's bar: ~36% H2 needed to hold ~$1.6bn); FY EBITDA guide raised to ~$1.66bn (implied Q4 ~$492m), but FY adj net income ~$840m and EPS ~$0.61 unchanged. 2027 outlook: $6.4bn revenue, $2.24bn EBITDA, $0.90 EPS. Personal-loan discount rate 4.97%->5.56%, cumulative FV adjustments $2.03bn->$1.40bn.

guidance.detail: Revenue and EBITDA guides raised; net income/EPS maintained; new 2027 outlook. Street level for 2027 not verified.

call.detail: Webcast at 08:00 ET per the release; content not reviewed in time.

public_reaction.summary: No same-day analyst actions or price coverage found by 09:19 ET; search returned only prior-cycle articles.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 15.96 = +10.4% vs 14.46 prev close, beyond the 8.5% implied move and far above the -1.5% release read. Active pre-market (259 prints, 31 in last 30m, last 09:15, not stale). Ran to a 16.41 high then sagged to ~15.96. Short position is down ~9.5% vs 14.535 entry. Market flat-up (SPY +0.26%, IWM +0.42%).

thesis_check.note: Fair-value marks took the rate hit the thesis named and net income guide was only held, but EBITDA guide was raised and a strong 2027 outlook was added, which the market is reading as a clear positive.

expected.open_lag_note: Pre-market is active and not stale, so the open should hold most of the +10%; a gap beyond the implied move that already sagged from its high tends to give part back in the first half hour, partly offset by a 17% short float that may keep covering.

recommendation.reason: De short staat ongeveer 10% verlies omdat SoFi voorbeurs ruim boven de verwachte beweging stijgt na een verhoogde winstprognose en een sterke 2027-vooruitblik. Grote openingssprongen geven vaak een deel terug in het eerste halfuur, dus we dekken om 10:00 in plaats van op de opening. Langer vasthouden riskeert verdere short-dekking door de hoge shortpositie.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 doorstijgt boven de voorbeurs-top van 16,41, dan direct op de opening dekken (exit_open).
